scope: Test-only native AI/PDF exact scratch-frame reuse; full-format/viewer qualification is separate
change: General same-coordinate groups consume/reset the existing single scratch frame; non-retained End returns its child to that same slot. Different-space entry still releases the slot. No larger cache or sample skipping.

correctness.reference: Fresh execution stack independently for every fragment; exact Pixel storage equality
correctness.faults: Every admission refusal/cancellation checkpoint of nested-group fixture releases all credit; missing sources and retry checked
correctness.negative_control: Old policy deliberately fails the allocation-regression assertion:33 frame-size requests versus48 fresh-reference requests

benchmark.scope: Pixel replay only; excludes scene recording and profiling histograms
benchmark.timing_scope: One complex pixel (199,25), excludes scene preparation; same frozen binary, no histogram in timing runs
benchmark.variability: Raw timings vary; all runs and discarded warmups retained

provenance.note: Only the additional refusal/cancellation test was appended after the timing binary was frozen; optimized function source unchanged

limitations: Experimental CPU compositor; no production AI opening speedup claim
Credit request counts are not malloc-event counts or RSS
One-pixel benchmark does not establish full-page or100format throughput
Normal4M heavy pixels/full-page completion and independent AI geometry/color fidelity remain open
